table.name: people
table.purpose: Registry of individuals (people) with their personal attributes: name, birth date, height, and nationality. Each person is referenced one-to-one by a row in poker_player, which extends this table with poker-specific data. The names (e.g. Aleksey Ostapenko, Roman Bragin, Sergey Grankin) and heights (~182–207 cm) match professional volleyball players, suggesting the dataset was seeded with athlete biographical data, but the table itself is a generic people table.

Birth_Date.name: Birth_Date
Birth_Date.description: Person's date of birth, stored as formatted text (e.g. 'May 26, 1986') rather than a date type.

Height.name: Height
Height.description: Person's height in centimeters (range 182–207, mean ~195, consistent with athletes such as volleyball players).

Nationality.name: Nationality
Nationality.description: Person's country of nationality (e.g. Russia, Bulgaria).

People_ID.name: People_ID
People_ID.description: Primary key identifying each person; referenced one-to-one by poker_player.People_ID, so this table holds shared personal attributes while poker_player holds poker-specific ones.

table.name: poker_player
table.purpose: One row per poker player, holding poker-specific career statistics (earnings, money rank, final tables, best finish) and a link to the person's core biographical record in the people table.

Best_Finish.name: Best_Finish
Best_Finish.description: Player's best finishing position in a tournament (1 = first place / champion); values 1-3 in this data.

Earnings.name: Earnings
Earnings.description: Total tournament prize money earned by the player, in US dollars (range ~104,871 to ~596,462).

Final_Table_Made.name: Final_Table_Made
Final_Table_Made.description: Number of final tables the player has reached (count, 10-42 in this data).

Money_Rank.name: Money_Rank
Money_Rank.description: Player's ranking on the all-time money list (lower is better; 58-166 in this data).

People_ID.name: People_ID
People_ID.description: Foreign key to people.People_ID, identifying the person record for this poker player; one-to-one with the people table.

Poker_Player_ID.name: Poker_Player_ID
Poker_Player_ID.description: Primary key of the poker_player table; unique identifier for each poker player record.
